Bank fraud alert
[Bank]: Did you authorize $487.32 at Walmart? Reply Y/N. If not, verify now: hxxps://bank-secure-verify[.]example/login
Why it works: real bank name, amount, urgency. Red flag: link + “reply Y/N”.

Account locked
Apple ID: Your account is locked due to suspicious activity. Verify within 24 hours: hxxps://appleid-verify[.]example
Red flag: shortened/odd domain, deadline, login request.

Delivery fee
USPS: Your package is held at the depot due to incomplete address. Pay $1.99 redelivery fee: hxxps://usps-redelivery[.]example/track
Red flag: small fee to lower suspicion; unofficial link.

Unpaid toll
E-ZPass: You have an unpaid toll of $6.95. Avoid a $50 late fee: hxxps://ezpass-pay[.]example
Red flag: toll agencies usually direct you to official site, not random link.

Utility disconnection
Your electricity service will be disconnected today. Call 1-555-0100 to pay immediately.
Red flag: same-day threat; number in text; payment pressure.

OTP forwarding scam
Hi, this is Ahmed. I accidentally sent my verification code to your number. Can you forward it? It’s urgent.
Red flag: never share OTPs. This is account takeover.

Job offer
Hi, I’m HR at [Company]. We saw your CV. Work from home, $35/hr, 2 hrs/day. No interview needed. WhatsApp +1-555-0199.
Red flag: no interview, WhatsApp-only, unrealistic pay.

Crypto withdrawal
Coinbase: Your withdrawal is pending. Confirm wallet access: hxxps://coinbase-wallet-check[.]example
Red flag: fake exchange domain; seed phrase/wallet login theft.

Wrong-number romance
Hey is this Dr. Ayesha? Sorry, wrong number. You seem kind. What do you do for work?
Red flag: “wrong number” then relationship building; eventually investment/crypto ask.

Family emergency
Mom, I broke my phone. This is my new number. I need $850 for rent urgently. Can you Zelle me?
Red flag: new number + urgent money + payment app.

Tax refund
IRS: You have an unclaimed refund of $1,240. Submit bank details here: hxxps://irs-refund[.]example
Red flag: tax agencies don’t request bank details by text link.

Tech support
Microsoft: Your device is infected with 5 viruses. Call 1-555-0123 immediately.
Red flag: unsolicited infection warning; call-center scam.

Subscription failed
Netflix: Your payment failed. Update your billing info within 24h: hxxps://netflix-billing[.]example
Red flag: fake login page; credential theft.

Prize/gift card
Congratulations! You won a $500 gift card. Claim here: hxxps://reward-claim[.]example
Red flag: you didn’t enter; claim link; data/payment harvesting.

CEO/gift-card fraud
Hi, this is the CEO. I’m in a meeting. Please buy 5 x $100 gift cards and send me the codes. Urgent.
Red flag: gift-card codes are a classic BEC scam.

Invoice scam
Invoice INV-8841 attached. Please pay today to avoid service interruption: hxxps://invoice-pay[.]example
Red flag: unexpected invoice; link instead of known portal.

Rental scam
Apartment still available. $600/month. Send deposit today and I’ll courier keys.
Red flag: deposit before viewing; pressure; no verified contract.

Charity scam
Donate to flood relief: every $10 feeds a family. Send to hxxps://relief-donate[.]example
Red flag: emotional urgency; unverified charity; direct payment link.

Loan scam
Pre-approved $5,000 loan. No credit check. Pay $75 processing fee to release funds.
Red flag: upfront fee; guaranteed approval.

Warranty scam
Your car warranty has expired. Renew today or lose coverage: 1-555-0177.
Red flag: vague vehicle details; call-back number.

Travel scam
Your flight is canceled. Rebook now and pay $49 fee: hxxps://airline-rebook[.]example
Red flag: airline would use official app/booking reference.

Pet scam
I found your dog. I can keep it safe but need $100 for vet check. Send gift card code.
Red flag: payment by gift card; emotional pressure.

Government benefits
SNAP: Your benefits are suspended. Verify identity to restore: hxxps://benefits-verify[.]example
Red flag: government impersonation; identity theft.

Insurance verification
Your health insurance needs verification or claims will be denied. Upload ID and card: hxxps://insurance-check[.]example
Red flag: sensitive document request by text link.

Sextortion
I have webcam footage of you. Pay $900 in Bitcoin within 48h or I send it to your contacts.
Red flag: mass-sent fear tactic; often no real footage.

QR-code scam
Scan this QR to pay your parking fee: [QR image]
Red flag: QR codes can hide malicious payment links; verify official app.

Common scam text types
Smishing/phishing: fake bank, Apple, PayPal, delivery, tax links.

OTP interception: “send me the code” / “wrong number” code forwarding.

Bank impersonation: fraud alerts, account lock, card activation.

Delivery/parcel scams: unpaid fee, address issue, redelivery.

Toll/utility scams: unpaid toll, disconnection notice.

Job scams: work-from-home, task scams, fake recruiters, WhatsApp/Telegram interviews.

Investment/crypto scams: fake exchanges, wallet verification, “guaranteed returns”, pig-butchering.

Romance/wrong-number scams: relationship building then money/investment ask.

Family emergency scams: new number, urgent money, Zelle/gift card.

Government impersonation: IRS/tax, benefits, fines, immigration.

Tech support scams: virus warnings, Microsoft/Apple support calls.

Subscription renewal scams: Netflix, antivirus, cloud storage payment failed.

Prize/lottery scams: gift cards, vouchers, “claim now”.

CEO/BEC/invoice scams: gift cards, wire transfer, fake invoice.

Rental/real-estate scams: deposit before viewing.

Charity scams: disaster relief, medical fundraising.

Loan/debt scams: upfront fee, no credit check.

Warranty/insurance scams: car warranty, health insurance verification.

Travel scams: canceled flight, rebooking fee.

Pet scams: lost/found pet, adoption fee.

Sextortion scams: webcam threats, Bitcoin demand.

Refund scams: overpayment refund, fake order cancellation.

QR-code scams: parking meters, menus, payment codes.

SIM-swap/social engineering: carrier port-out, account takeover.
